description: 🚀 Complete toolkit for generating production-ready .NET 8 microservices with DDD, CQRS, Clean Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, and comprehensive infrastructure. Generate enterprise-grade microservices with REST APIs, CQRS, MongoDB read models, RabbitMQ messaging, external service integration, Docker, and complete testing suite.
releaseNotes: 🚀 v0.4.5 - Templates Included: Fixed missing templates in NuGet package. All microservice templates are now properly included and accessible via CLI commands (list, describe, generate).
